facts.fact: Lands Permanent Secretary Prosper Matondi told The Herald the ministry is implementing a land information management system, with the rollout of a digital land management system expected to improve administration within six months.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands and Rural Development

facts.fact: Lands Permanent Secretary Prosper Matondi told The Herald the ministry is creating a single, integrated national land registry as part of a land information management system, replacing records held in Excel and Access.
